name: G-Force
decision_note: Real climate-tech pre-seed VC/program (with Founders Factory) managing the EuVECA fund G-Force Fund j.s.a., but its statements show no new investment in 2025 and no dated deal since Oct 2024 was found.

evidence.quote: Launched in partnership with G-Force (the “G” is for “green”) based out of Bratislava, Slovakia, the program will look to invest in and accelerate climate tech startups.

In partnership with G-Force, Founders Factory Sustainability Seed Program will be a leading pre/seed program committed to building and supporting the ventures that will have a positive impact on the world.

Startups selected for the program will get a seed investment of up to €150,000, six months of startup support using Founders Factory’s team, as well as introductions to potential customers, partners, corporates and investors.
G-Force Fund, j. s. a. je európsky fond rizikového kapitálu (EuVECA) s právnou formou
The idea is that any ecotech venture in any location in the world can apply and join the program.

Zhromažďovanie peňažných prostriedkov od investorov s cieľom investovať ich v súlade s určenou investičnou politikou v prospech osôb, ktorých peňažné prostriedky boli zhromaždené podľa zákona č. 203/2011 Z.z. o kolektívnom investovaní

analyst_notes: Inactivity basis: G-Force Fund j.s.a. 2025 cash-flow statement (RÚZ attachment 12786796) shows no payments for acquisitions of financial investments in 2025 (EUR 50k in 2024, EUR 100k in 2023, dates within the year unknown); portfolio at end-2025 EUR 1.46m (shares, stakes, convertible loans), no events after year-end. The manager G-Force s.r.o. (owner Global Connect Corporation SK, linked to Marian Gazdík) holds the fund and a token stake in Climate Karma Solutions Inc.; its 2025 income is mostly grants. Website gforce.vc is listed for sale. Crowdfund Insider (Oct 2023) reported a EUR 20m 'G-Force Fund II' open from May 2023; no Slovak vehicle for it was found in ORSR and no 2025-26 deals were found - if Fund II deals after 2024-10-25 surface, re-screen as include. Global Connect Corporation SK is also a shareholder of IPM Growth (sk-reference/ipm-growth). Web search budget exhausted during the screen.
